nodes.body: This branch only recognizes the textual `SpecialRegister`/`Label` form of `SRZ`, but `lift_cubin_to_ptx` supplies instructions from `SassDisassembler::decode_128bit`, which currently represents CS2R sources as `SassOperand::Register` and leaves modifiers empty (`disassembler.rs:401-419, 425-443`). Consequently a binary `CS2R R8, SRZ` cannot match the pair branch and now falls into this unsupported diagnostic instead of emitting either write. Decode the CS2R special-register field as `SRZ` (or otherwise preserve that information before this guard) so the binary lifting path receives the same semantics as the text path.
